title: Zakat and Ushr First Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Zakat and Ushr First Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ZAKAT AND USHR (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ZAKAT AND USHR
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXV OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 30th July, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
30-7-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Zakat and Ushr
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002. .
(2) It shall come into force at
once except in Islamabad Capital Territory where it shall come into force on
such date as the Federal Government may, by notification in the official
Gazette, specify.

2. Amendment of section 2,
Ordinance XVIII of 1980.---In the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980 (XVIII of
1980), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, in clause
(xxix), after the word "Committee" occurring for the second time, the
words "or Town Committee" shall be inserted.

(a)

"(1)
In each district, a District Zakat and Ushr Committee, in the Islamabad Capital Territory, the Islamabad Zakat and
